title: Connecticut Business Registry Active Organizations
description: Governed official Connecticut Secretary-of-the-State active-registration organization layer with selected non-personal fields, source-specific status and sub-status, reported business-address ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
